title: Sundial — Omnes vulnerant ultima necat
description: An original modeled limestone sundial, satin brass bezel and solid triangular gnomon in a charcoal studio. Engraved Roman hour numerals, fine radial marks, procedural stone microtexture, real directional-light shadows, and a slow camera arc.
authorship: Scene geometry, procedural materials, lighting and camera animation authored specifically for this project in create_sundial.py.
render_engine: Blender 4.3.2 Eevee Next, CPU software EGL
motion: Sun-light rotation physically moves the gnomon's cast shadow. Camera moves on a short arc. Four scene poses per second are rendered and motion-interpolated with FFmpeg to 24 fps.
framing: Dial above center with lower-third negative space for later caption compositing. No quote or brand baked into source footage.
attribution: Original project artwork; no NASA imagery, archive footage, stock footage, or third-party model is used.
instrument_note: Hour marks are an artistic arrangement for the film, not a latitude-calibrated measuring instrument.

verification.decode_check: FFmpeg full-file decode completed with no errors
